parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

patch.summary: Bulk update project details for company users on projects
patch.description: This endpoint allows company users to bulk update their project details on multiple projects. Users must already be assigned to the project before their project details (roles, permission templates) can be updated.

schema.title: Company User Body Bulk Update Project Details

users.title: Company Users Bulk Update Project Details
users.description: Array of existing company users with a permission template id, project_role_ids, and project id that they want updated. The maximum amount per request is 1000 user_id, project_id, project_role_ids, permission_template_id objects. If more than 1000 objects are sent then a worker will be triggered to perform the action asynchronously.

user_id.description: The ID of the user update

project_id.description: The ID of user's project to update

permission_template_id.description: The ID of the permission template to update for the user

project_role_ids.description: An array of project role IDs to assign to the user for the project

entities.description: One key for each user ID passed in, with an array of project IDs for that nested user ID

userId.description: User Id of the user that was added to the project

projects.description: One key for each project ID for the user ID

projectId.description: Project Id of the project the user's project details were updated for

message.description: Descriptive message of the successful mutation

errors.description: One key for each user ID passed in, with an array of project IDs for that nested user ID

errors.description: One key for each project ID for the user ID

projectId.description: Project Id of the project the user's project details were updated for

message.description: Descriptive message of the unsuccessful mutation

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"users\":[{\"user_id\":\"12345\",\"project_id\":\"23456\",\"permission_template_id\":\"34567\",\"project_role_ids\":[\"45678\"]}]}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/users/bulk_update_project_details", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.description:
Gracefully handle already assigned project roles in bulk update of project details for users. This also slightly

x-changelog.summary: Bulk remove reports group-managed memberships as skipped
x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, bulk removing users from projects no
longer removes memberships managed by Groups. Those project results are
reported with a `skipped_managed` status instead of `success`, and the
memberships are retained. Behavior is unchanged when the feature is off.
